therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: dopaminergic pathway modulation reducing sensorimotor symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Japanese patients with idiopathic restless legs syndrome
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in IRLS total score at 6 weeks

results.effect_size: IRLS score change from baseline: -12.3 (0.25 mg), -12.5 (0.5 mg), -11.8 (0.75 mg) points
subgroup_findings: IRLS responder rate at week 6: 60.4% (0.25 mg), 58.5% (0.5 mg), 49.1% (0.75 mg)
At 52 weeks open-label, IRLS responder rates: 100% (0.125 mg), 90% (0.25 mg), 92% (0.5 mg), 68% (0.75 mg)
No augmentation observed at 52 weeks across all dose groups
safety_signals: Blood pressure increased: 1 participant in 0.5 mg group during double-blind period
Cardiovascular disorder: 1 participant in 0.75 mg group during double-blind period
Serious adverse events included gastroenteritis bacterial and colon cancer in 0.5 mg double-blind group
Open-label serious adverse events included breast cancer, hepatic malignant neoplasm, maculopathy, acute pancreatitis, fall, spinal compression fracture in 0.25 mg group, and asthma in 0.125 mg group

context.comparator: no placebo arm; active dose comparison only
context.duration: 6-week double-blind period followed by 52-week open-label period
